Menu — Heatmap — inside Editor, picks the colour palette the editor is drawn in
Note — the module plays nothing until a program has been typed into the editor and evaluated; typing changes only the draft
Note — Ctrl+Enter evaluates the statement under the cursor on the next quarter beat, and Ctrl+period evaluates the whole document
Note — Ctrl+Space mutes and unmutes this module in phase with the others, and Ctrl+R restarts it from its arrangement
Note — with a Transport patched to RUN, Ctrl+Shift+Space plays or pauses it and Ctrl+Shift+R restarts it from beat zero
Note — this module is marked beta by its maker, who says the syntax and behaviour of the language may change
